name: mech-reverify-weekly
prompt: Re-run the mech design verification for the checked-in mechanical design. Run `/mech:gates` on the workspace brief (or `python3 $MECH_PLUGIN/scripts/mech_launcher.py gates --brief <brief.json> --out <out_dir>`), compare the verdicts to the recorded ones in the design report, and write a short result to observations/mech/. If any gate regressed from pass to fail or unknown, say so explicitly in the run summary.
